title: Our Outreach
body: Veteran John Outreach meets people where they are -- in the streets, in shelters, at encampments, and in our community -- with practical help, genuine relationships, and hope for what's ahead.

deck.title: Relief
deck.subtitle: We provide immediate, practical help like food, clothing, hygiene items, and essential supplies to meet urgent needs.

deck.title: Relationship
deck.subtitle: We build genuine connections and walk alongside people with compassion, dignity, and respect.

deck.title: Restoration
deck.subtitle: We encourage hope, opportunity, and a brighter tomorrow through support, guidance, and meaningful relationships.

deck.title: Winter Relief
deck.subtitle: Warm clothing, blankets, and life-saving supplies when temperatures drop

deck.title: Spring Preparation
deck.subtitle: Hygiene supplies, resources, and connections for a fresh start.

deck.title: Annual Retreat
deck.subtitle: A time of rest, encouragement, and renewal for veterans in our community.

deck.title: Summer Hydration
deck.subtitle: Water, hygiene items, and outreach in high-heat conditions.

deck.title: Back to School
deck.subtitle: School supplies and support for veteran families and their children.

deck.title: Fall/Holiday Outreach
deck.subtitle: Meals, warm clothing, and hope during the holiday season.

deck.title: Women's Outreach
deck.subtitle: Support, resources, and community for women veterans on their journey forward.

deck.title: Annual Retreat
deck.subtitle: A time of rest, reflection, and renewal for veterans in our community.

deck.title: Hydration Outreach
deck.subtitle: Keeping our community safe and healthy during the hot summer months.

deck.title: Seasonal Relief
deck.subtitle: Warm clothing, meals, and essential supplies when people need it most.
